note: Taste-and-see: bless, soul-boast, magnify, sought/freed-of-fears, radiant, poor's cry, taste, fear/no-lack, seek, teach-the-fear, desire-life, guard-tongue, seek-peace, brokenhearted, refuge

277128.gloss: bless the LORD at all times

dims.v: bless the LORD at all times
the self resolves to bless the LORD at all times, his praise continually in the mouth - unbroken praise
v1: 'I will BLESS the LORD at all times; his PRAISE shall continually be in my mouth' - the operation is praise made ceaseless, a standing posture of the interior.

277213.gloss: my soul boasts in the LORD

dims.v: my soul boasts in the LORD
the self's soul makes its boast in the LORD, that the humble may hear and be glad - glorying redirected to God
v2: 'My SOUL makes its BOAST in the LORD; let the HUMBLE hear and be GLAD' - the operation is boasting turned from self to God; the interior's pride is relocated onto him.
the self calls others to magnify the LORD and exalt his name together - praise made communal
v3: 'Oh, MAGNIFY the LORD with me, and let us EXALT his name together' - the operation reaches out: the interior wants company in enlarging God.

277244.gloss: I sought the LORD, freed from fears

dims.v: I sought the LORD, freed from fears
the self sought the LORD, who answered and delivered it from all its fears - seeking that dissolves dread
v4: 'I SOUGHT the LORD, and he answered me and delivered me from all my FEARS' - the operation is the turning-to-God that empties the interior of its fears.

277254.gloss: those who look to him are radiant

dims.v: those who look to him are radiant
those who look to God are radiant, their faces never ashamed - the interior lit up by looking to him
v5: 'Those who LOOK to him are RADIANT, and their faces shall never be ashamed' - the operation is transformation by gaze: the interior that turns to God is lit and kept from shame.

277260.gloss: this poor man cried and was heard

dims.v: this poor man cried and was heard
this poor man cried, and the LORD heard and saved him from all his troubles - the cry of the lowly answered
v6: 'This poor man CRIED, and the LORD HEARD him and SAVED him out of all his troubles' - the operation is the lowly cry that reaches God; poverty of estate is no barrier to being heard.

277275.gloss: taste and see that the LORD is good

dims.v: taste and see that the LORD is good
the self invites others to taste and see that the LORD is good - trust made experiential, savoured

v8: 'Oh, TASTE and see that the LORD is GOOD! Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him!' - the operation is a summons to first-hand experience; the interior is to sample God's goodness, not just hear of it.

277284.gloss: fear the LORD, you his saints

dims.v: fear the LORD, you his saints
the self calls the saints to fear the LORD, for those who fear him have no lack - reverent fear that wants nothing
v9: 'Oh, FEAR the LORD, you his saints, for those who fear him have no LACK!' - the operation commends reverence as the interior posture that is fully supplied.

277140.gloss: those who seek the LORD lack no good

dims.v: those who seek the LORD lack no good
the young lions hunger, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing - seeking that is satisfied
v10: 'those who SEEK the LORD lack no GOOD thing' - distinct from v4's seeking-freed-from-fear: this seeking is answered with provision; the interior that seeks God wants for nothing good.

277148.gloss: I will teach you the fear of the LORD

dims.v: I will teach you the fear of the LORD
the self calls children to listen and be taught the fear of the LORD - passing on reverence
v11: 'Come, O children, listen to me; I will TEACH you the FEAR of the LORD' - the operation turns instructor: the interior wants to hand its reverence to others.

277154.gloss: who desires life and to see good

dims.v: who desires life and to see good
the self names the one who desires life and loves many days to see good - the longing the psalm will answer

v12: 'What man is there who DESIRES life and LOVES many days, that he may see GOOD?' - the operation surfaces a universal want - a good, long life - and prepares to redirect it toward the fear of God.
the self teaches: keep the tongue from evil and the lips from deceit - the guarded mouth as the path to life
v13: 'KEEP your tongue from EVIL and your lips from speaking DECEIT' - the operation is the governed tongue; the interior that wants good life must first police its speech.
the self teaches: turn from evil, do good, seek peace and pursue it - an active chase after peace
v14: 'Turn away from evil and do good; SEEK PEACE and PURSUE it' - the operation makes peace a quarry: the interior does not merely wish peace but hunts it.
the LORD is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit - the shattered interior is where God draws closest
v18: 'The LORD is NEAR to the BROKENHEARTED and saves the CRUSHED in SPIRIT' - the operation names the crushed interior not as abandoned but as the very place of God's nearness.

277236.gloss: none who take refuge are condemned

dims.v: none who take refuge are condemned
the LORD redeems the life of his servants; none who take refuge in him will be condemned - shelter that guarantees acquittal

v22: 'The LORD REDEEMS the life of his servants; none of those who TAKE REFUGE in him will be condemned' - the operation closes the acrostic on refuge: the interior that shelters in God is safe from condemnation.
v4: 'and he ANSWERED me' - the response the seeking received.
v6: 'and the LORD HEARD him' - the divine hearing that answered the poor man's cry.
v18: 'and SAVES the crushed in spirit' - the rescue God brings to the broken interior.
